system.description:
You solidify your Earth Release chakra into 2 small Shimmering Crystalline Gems. The Gems can be any color you choose and they float around you for the duration. You can spend your gems to enhanced other Earth release jutsu. By spending 1 Golden Gem, when you cast a Ninjutsu with the Earth Release keyword, you are able to enhance it in one the following ways:

Reinforce: If the jutsu cast summons a construct or structure, increase its hit points by 2d8.

Harden: If the jutsu cast would grant a creature temporary hit points, increase the THP gained by +8 Hit points.

Solidify: If the jutsu cast would deal damage, increase the damage dealt by 1 damage die.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and you generate 1 additional Gem. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank, increase Reinforces hit point bonus by 2d8, Harden’s THP bonus by +8 and Solidifies bonus damage by +4. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank increase Reinforces hit point bonus by 4d8, Harden’s THP bonus by +16 and Solidifies bonus damage by +8.
